name: 陳彥安
objective:
本課程旨在深入學習無線網路技術，從基本概念到進階應用，全面涵蓋網路架構中的實體層、媒體存取層、網路層與傳輸層技術議題。課程內容將引導學生探索通訊網路的基礎理論，了解訊號傳遞的特性及頻譜與調變技術，並掌握多重存取方法的原理與應用。此外，課程將深入探討無線區域網路、藍牙、ZigBee 等短距離通訊技術，並延伸至即時網路環境中的 Ad hoc 路由設計。在應用層上，學生將學習無線感測網路的架構與應用，以及定位系統的設計。課程亦探討行動網路的原理與發展，並涵蓋近期的技術進展與創新，幫助學生掌握無線網路技術的現狀與未來趨勢，進一步提升應用能力與實務經驗。

(1) 簡介
(2) 無線通訊實體層議題
(3) 無線通訊媒體存取層議題
(4) 無線區域網路系統
(5) 無線個人網路系統
(6) 網路應用架構與定位技術
(7) 行動通訊網路系統
(8) 近期技術發展

This course provides an in-depth exploration of wireless network technology, from foundational concepts to advanced applications. It covers key topics across the physical, media access, network, and transport layers, including signal transmission, spectrum, modulation, and multiple access methods. Students will study short-range communication technologies such as WLAN, Bluetooth, and ZigBee, as well as Ad hoc routing in real-time networks. The course also addresses wireless sensor networks, positioning system design, mobile network principles, and recent advancements. Emphasis is placed on practical skills and understanding future trends in wireless networking.

(1) Introduction
(2) Wireless Physical Layer
(3) Wireless MAC
(4) Wireless Local Area Networks
(5) Wireless Person Area Networks
(6) Wirelss Application and Localization
(7) Mobile Communication Networks
(8) Recent Advances
